facts.text: I did an analysis of a covid call centre for medical professionals.
The first dataset in my analysis counts calls containing the keyword "Error".
The "Error" keyword in my analysis referred to Vaccine Errors.
The second dataset in my analysis outlines the number of webinars for medical professionals.
The second dataset in my analysis also includes the number of newsletters sent out related to Covid 19 Vaccine Errors.
The third dataset in my analysis is the number of Covid vaccines given in relation to date.
I asked for trends and for how the three data sets might relate to each other.

events.text: Analysis requested for trends across three time-series datasets (Error calls, Covid communications, and weekly Covid vaccinations).
